version.changelog:
- Adds Node.js as a required runtime dependency for QR PNG generation; skill now requires both python3 and node.
- Updates install metadata and instructions to include Node.js, with Homebrew steps for macOS.
- Introduces a dependency on the Python Pillow module for QR/image handling.
- Adds a "doctor" diagnostic command to scripts/publisher_cli.py for preflight checks (`doctor --check-network --strict`).
- Documentation and usage examples are updated to reflect new dependencies and improved troubleshooting guidance.
- Improves reliability of QR login and clarifies image handling in messaging platforms.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and install steps are consistent with its stated purpose (QR login + publish/edit operations for the Z视介 platform); nothing requested or installed is disproportionate to that goal.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included CLI and JSON API contract. Required binaries (python3, node) are justified: python runs the CLI and node is used for QR PNG generation (qrcode JS asset). The declared default host and API endpoints align with the skill's publishing purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md describes exactly the QR-based login flow, when to call prepare-login/wait-login, how to present inline QR images to chat, and how to build/pass JSON payloads. It explicitly limits exposing low-level login details unless asked. The included release helper is for publishing the skill and is documented.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install steps are simple Homebrew formulas for python and node (low risk). No archives or external arbitrary downloads are performed by the install spec. The bundle is code-included (no remote install URLs).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or unrelated credentials. It stores and reuses a sessionId cookie in a local temp session file (expected for this workflow). The hard-coded QR signing seed is documented as an implementation constant rather than a secret; this is consistent with implementing the client-side poll signature logic.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request permanent/global privileges. It writes only its own session and temp artifacts and does not modify other skills' configs. The release helper may invoke 'clawhub' or 'npx clawhub@latest' when publishing — that action requires explicit user execution.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: generate QR codes, wait for a Z视介 scan, extract sessionId, then post/edit content on the documented endpoints. Before installing, note: (1) using it will prompt users to scan a login QR — that grants the skill a session token capable of publishing as that account, so only use it for accounts you trust; (2) sessionId is persisted locally in a temp file; inspect or rotate it if concerned; (3) confirm the default publish host (https://zugcpublish.cztv.com) and replace with your environment if needed; (4) the bundled upload endpoints are placeholder TODOs — do not enable automated media uploads until you supply real upload endpoints; (5) be cautious running scripts/release_to_clawhub.py --execute since it will call clawhub or npx to publish the skill externally. If you want extra assurance, review scripts/publisher_cli.py for the network requests and cookie/session extraction logic before use.
